arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kirby argued the tribe seeks a categorical rule for immunity.
He claimed this rule would shield tribal property from state warrants.
He stated this immunity would cover casinos and commercial businesses.
He noted this rule would block state crime investigations and prosecutions.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether state law enforcement can execute search warrants on tribal land. The county argues it needs access to investigate crimes. The tribe argues its property is immune from state process.
